angle_gap: Defines skill gap and lists generic analysis steps (identify required skills, note desired level, compare to current workforce) but never works through an actual example — no sample skill matrix, no role-by-role breakdown. It also misnames the underlying framework, calling it the 'Defryus model' instead of the Dreyfus model of skill acquisition, and leans on vague, unsourced stats ('35% of employees feel...').
asset: Closing the Skill Gap Role by Role — A Worked Analysis for Technical, Sales, and Frontline Teams
distinct_angle: Walks through a real skill-gap analysis with an actual skill matrix and role-by-role worked example, and gets the underlying Dreyfus skill-acquisition model right — the concrete detail and accuracy this page skips.

angle_gap: The 'identify potential leaders' and 'assess current leaders' skills' steps — the two steps that matter most — are one line each with no methodology: no competency framework, no assessment criteria, no worked example of how to actually spot or evaluate a high-potential employee. Stats cited (63% of millennials, 38% of new leaders failing within 18 months) are given without a source or year.
asset: How to Actually Identify High-Potential Leaders Before You Invest in Developing Them
distinct_angle: Replaces this page's one-line 'identify potential leaders' step with a real assessment framework and worked selection criteria — the methodology this page never provides.
